notes: «حدثنا أبي» with no name is a relation to the compiler's own father (kind relation); «قالا» makes the pair one level
«سمع من سلمان ومن أبي ذر ومن المقداد» is rule 5: three sources, one level; the Prophet is the end
«عرضه على جابر وابن عباس فقالا صدقوا» is an attestation after the saying, not written as a route: left out
«- رضي الله عنهما -» blessings are not part of any surface
